trigger: Teacher requests multi-lesson unit or sequence plan aligned to Australian Curriculum v9.0
required_sources: ACARA Australian Curriculum v9.0 (Class 1): content descriptions achievement standards year-level descriptions
proposed_outputs: Unit overview (duration, year level, learning area, curriculum codes), sequence of 5-10 lesson-level learning intentions mapped to content descriptions, assessment checkpoints mapped to achievement standards, differentiation notes per lesson, curriculum mapping table (content description to lesson to evidence)
eval_scenario_1: Year 4 Mathematics unit on fractions (AC9M4N01-AC9M4N04) - mapping accuracy and coverage
eval_scenario_2: Year 7 HASS unit on Ancient Egypt (AC9HH7K01-AC9HH7K04) - cross-curriculum priority integration Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures
eval_scenario_3: Year 9 Science unit on ecosystems (AC9S9U01-AC9S9U03) - achievement-standard evidence alignment across lessons
overlap_lesson_plan_creation: High overlap (lesson-level planning) - new skill operates at unit/sequence grain (weeks) not lesson grain (hours)

trigger: Teacher requests explicit integration of General Capabilities or Cross-Curriculum Priorities into lesson or unit
required_sources: ACARA Australian Curriculum v9.0 (Class 1): General Capabilities continua Cross-Curriculum Priorities organising ideas elaborations
proposed_outputs: Capability/priority audit of existing lesson/unit, tagged learning activities with capability elements and organising ideas, explicit teaching prompts for capability development, evidence-of-learning suggestions per capability/priority
eval_scenario_1: Year 6 English persuasive writing - embed Critical and Creative Thinking Ethical Understanding
eval_scenario_2: Year 8 Geography unit on water scarcity - embed Sustainability CCP and Numeracy capability
eval_scenario_3: Year 3 HASS unit on local history - embed Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures CCP and Intercultural Understanding
overlap_lesson_plan_creation: Moderate overlap (capability tags in lesson outputs)

trigger: Teacher requests planning support for QCAA General Senior Syllabus internal assessment instrument (IA1 IA2 IA3) task design syllabus objective coverage ISMG alignment conditions authentication
required_sources: QCAA General Senior Syllabuses (Class 2): syllabus objectives unit subject matter assessment specifications ISMGs sample assessment instruments subject reports confirmation submission information
proposed_outputs: Instrument plan: selected syllabus objectives, task type and conditions, draft task sheet, ISMG criteria mapping table, authentication strategies, timing and resource requirements, quality-assurance checklist against syllabus specifications
eval_scenario_1: Biology Unit 3 IA2 Student Experiment - design investigation task covering Unit 3 subject matter map to ISMG criteria (Research and planning Conducting Analysing Evaluating)
eval_scenario_2: Mathematical Methods Unit 3 IA1 Problem-solving and modelling task - map to ISMG criteria (Formulate Solve Evaluate and communicate)
eval_scenario_3: Modern History Unit 3 IA2 Investigation - independent source investigation map to ISMG criteria (Devising and conducting Analysing Synthesising Communicating)
data_dependencies: QCAA syllabus manifests data/curriculum/qcaa/*.json ISMG parsing sample instrument repository

trigger: Teacher requests feedback on student responses to QCAA internal assessment using ISMG or support for internal moderation/confirmation
target_users: Years 11-12 teachers Heads of Department moderation panels
required_sources: QCAA General Senior Syllabuses (Class 2): ISMGs for each instrument (IA1 IA2 IA3) sample marked responses subject reports quality assurance Confirmation submission information
proposed_outputs: Annotated student response with criterion-level judgements, feedback comments mapped to ISMG performance-level descriptors, moderation meeting preparation pack (evidence samples judgement consensus protocol) confirmation submission evidence checklist
eval_scenario_1: Biology IA2 Student Experiment - annotate sample student report against ISMG criteria produce feedback aligned to performance levels A-E
eval_scenario_2: English IA3 Extended response - moderate three student scripts across A-C range using ISMG record consensus judgements
eval_scenario_3: Mathematical Methods IA1 - apply ISMG to student modelling report identify evidence for each criterion at each performance level
tool_dependencies: ISMG parsing (structured criteria x performance levels)
data_dependencies: sample response corpus (QCAA published) moderation protocol templates

trigger: Teacher requests planning for reasonable adjustments (NCCD) or EAL/D support for students accessing F-10 Australian Curriculum or QCAA senior syllabuses
target_users: F-12 teachers Learning Support coordinators EAL/D specialists
required_sources: ACARA Australian Curriculum v9.0 (Class 1): Student Diversity advice EAL/D learning progression NCCD (Class 1/3): NCCD guidelines adjustment categories evidence requirements Queensland Department of Education (Class 2/3): Inclusive education policy EAL/D band scales reasonable adjustment resources
proposed_outputs: Adjustment plan: student profile, NCCD adjustment category (QDTP Supplementary Substantial Extensive), specific adjustments (presentation response setting timing), EAL/D band scale alignment, curriculum access strategies maintaining standards integrity, evidence-collection template for NCCD
eval_scenario_1: Year 5 Mathematics student with working memory difficulties - QDTP adjustments for fraction lesson (visual scaffolds chunked instructions)
eval_scenario_2: Year 9 EAL/D student (Band B) in Science - language scaffolds for research investigation (vocabulary pre-teaching sentence frames)
eval_scenario_3: Year 11 General Mathematics student with dyscalculia - Substantial adjustments for IA1 (formula sheet access extended time alternative representation)
tool_dependencies: NCCD adjustment matrix EAL/D band scales parser
overlap_lesson_plan_creation: None direct (explicitly excluded by skill boundary - see SKILL.md Differentiation vs reasonable adjustments vs curriculum modification)

trigger: Teacher requests support gathering organising and reporting evidence of student achievement against achievement standards (F-10) or reporting standards (Years 11-12)
required_sources: ACARA Australian Curriculum v9.0 (Class 1): achievement standards (F-10) work samples QCAA General/Applied Senior Syllabuses (Class 2): reporting standards A-E subject-specific standards elaborations confirmation/endorsement subject reports
proposed_outputs: Evidence portfolio template mapped to achievement standard/reporting standard descriptors, evidence-collection schedule across teaching period, on-balance judgement guide with annotated work samples, parent/student reporting language aligned to standard descriptors
eval_scenario_1: Year 2 English - collect evidence across reading writing speaking/listening for achievement standard produce semester report comments
eval_scenario_2: Year 10 Science - map portfolio items to achievement standard elements moderate on-balance judgement
eval_scenario_3: Year 12 Biology - align IA1/IA2/IA3 evidence to QCAA reporting standards A-E prepare confirmation submission
data_dependencies: work sample repository (ACARA/QCAA) reporting timeline templates

trigger: Teacher requests structured revision program or external assessment (EA) preparation for QCAA General Senior subjects with EA
required_sources: QCAA General Senior Syllabuses (Class 2): external assessment specifications past papers (2020-2025) marking guides subject reports formula/data books Key senior subject changes for EA 2026
proposed_outputs: Revision program: topic-sequence mapped to syllabus objectives and EA specifications, practice items modelled on past paper styles, marking-guide-aligned feedback templates, cognitive-load-managed schedule (spaced retrieval interleaving), exam-technique strategies per subject
eval_scenario_1: Mathematical Methods - 6-week EA prep program covering Units 3-4 practice combination-response and technology-free items marking guide alignment
eval_scenario_2: Chemistry - revision sequence targeting Data test (IA1) and EA examination past paper analysis for recurring concepts
eval_scenario_3: Modern History - EA preparation for extended response and short response source-analysis practice using past stimulus books
tool_dependencies: Past paper parsing (PDF) marking guide extraction EA specification parser spaced-repetition scheduler
